mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_account_token (uid, access_token, expires_at) VALUES (#{uid}, #{accessToken}, #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_token = VALUES(access_token), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT uid, access_token, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM weibo_account_token ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT uid, access_token, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM weibo_account_token WHERE expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
